hypothesis: High short interest plus price/event strength may identify squeeze-ready existing Ginger candidates, while high short crowding plus negative event context may identify fragile candidates. This run only checks whether new PIT short/borrow evidence exists after exp-20260504-041.

alpha_hypothesis.text: High short crowding plus existing breakout_long/trend_long strength or positive event context may be a squeeze setup tag; high short crowding plus negative filing/news/earnings context may be a fragile-short risk tag.
alpha_hypothesis.why_not_now: Prior same-family audits through exp-20260504-041 already found no PIT-safe short-interest, FINRA short-volume, or borrow-pressure rows. This recheck found no new local structured source files or adapters.

historical_experiment_check.mechanism_insight_check: docs/alpha-optimization-playbook.md ranks short interest / borrow pressure as a valid external overlay source, but only as shadow-quality until PIT data exists and explicitly warns not to treat FINRA daily short volume as short interest.

historical_experiment_check.why_not_simple_rerun: Rerunning squeeze shadow scoring without PIT rows would reproduce 0 taggable candidates and add no alpha evidence.

pit_risk_notes: Short-interest settlement dates are not tradable without publication dates.
FINRA daily short volume is trading activity, not short positioning.
News/headline mentions are unstructured and are not borrow-pressure evidence.
Without borrow_fee or shares_available, squeeze confidence must be downgraded.

examples: News headlines using squeeze for supply, margin, or cash-flow pressure are not short-squeeze evidence.
A headline mentioning short interest lacks settlement_date, publication_date, usable_trade_date, float, borrow fee, and shares-available fields.
Future FINRA daily short-volume rows must not be interpreted as short-interest positioning.

decision_rationale: The mechanism remains plausible as a future non-OHLCV overlay, but this run adds no new evidence beyond the earlier data-gap audits. Shadow scoring would be fabricated without real PIT-safe rows.
next_minimum_action: Choose one real default-off append-only short/borrow source and require publication_date plus usable_trade_date before rerunning shadow tagging. If only FINRA daily short volume is available, treat it as activity context, not short-interest positioning.
